name: Forbes Global 2000 Most Valuable Brands Dataset
description: Dataset derived from the Forbes list of the globally most valuable brands. It contains around 2,000 large companies with information about their market value, sales, profits, assets (in billion US$), industry, sector, and the country in which the company is located (3-letter country code).

variableMeasured.name: forbes_url
variableMeasured.description: Forbes URL identifying the company entry

variableMeasured.name: company
variableMeasured.description: Company name as listed by Forbes

variableMeasured.name: region
variableMeasured.description: Country or region associated with the company

variableMeasured.name: sales_figure
variableMeasured.description: Annual sales figure of the company
